00314.label: Days 1–4 · multiday cisplatin / fluorouracil

medicines.name: Multiday high-risk antiemetics
medicines.dose: Prescriber/pharmacist to complete the four-day schedule and delayed cover
medicines.timing: Before each treatment day and for two days after the final SACT day under NCIS multiday guidance

medicines.name: Cisplatin pre-hydration and electrolytes
medicines.dose: Individual prescription required

additional_support: Prescribe regimen-specific hydration and electrolyte replacement with fluid-balance review. The appropriate volume depends on kidney and cardiac status; a generic printed plan is not an intravenous-fluid prescription.

Record the DPD result before the first fluorouracil exposure unless previously tested. Complete deficiency precludes fluorouracil; partial deficiency needs an individual starting dose and careful subsequent review.
